production_issue: Assistant transcripts arrived after the audible greeting, but later synthesis was skipped because another microphone onset changed the captured playback generation while the backend was still waiting.

change.generation_interrupt: Only during active synthesis or queued audio playback
change.greeting_guard: Separate input_started flag preserves suppression when speech precedes backend startup
change.backend_side_effects: Submitted requests still settle; no request cancellation, replay, or automatic order confirmation

verification.regressions_before_fix: Three expected assertion failures: continuation muted reply, empty ASR muted pending reply, and 700 ms pause split into two utterances
verification.real_two_peer_rtp_test: Passed with substituted speech/dialog services; no live inference or order

limitations: Pauses longer than the configured endpoint still create separate turns.
The detector remains energy VAD and depends on browser echo cancellation.
This audio fix does not reduce ServiceNow agent/model processing time or change upstream English response text.
